decisions.decision: The Board consented to keep ARPA funds available and delegated to Interim Town Manager Terenzini the authority to make conclusive funding decisions, pending bid results (no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: the board consented unanimously, thereby delegating mr. terenzini with the authority to make conclusive funding decisions.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed more information is needed, including whether any approved development plans exist, before deciding on 56 Carr Avenue.
decisions.quote: the board agreed that further information is vital before proceeding with any decisions on 56 carr avenue

decisions.decision: A consensus permits consultant John Petrin to lead the primary questioning at candidate interviews, with Board members adding follow-up questions.
decisions.quote: a consensus emerged to permit petrin to lead the primary questioning, with board members integrating follow-up questions where needed.

decisions.decision: All Town Manager candidate interviews will take place on January 14, 2025, commencing at 5:30 PM.
decisions.quote: all interviews will take place on january 14th, commencing at 5:30 pm.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed to have Interim Town Manager Terenzini refine the comparison-community analysis (adding economic factors) and bring it back for review.
decisions.quote: they agreed to have mr. terenzini refine the analysis and bring it back for further review.

decisions.decision: Member Moore requested that the Interim Town Manager track and report on the volume of public records requests.
decisions.quote: member moore requested that the interim town manager track and report on the volume of public records requests being received.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed it would be prudent to invite Public Access Cable (PAC) representatives to an upcoming meeting to discuss solutions for the new municipal building.
decisions.quote: the board agreed it would be prudent to invite pac representatives to attend an upcoming meeting to discuss potential solutions.

decisions.decision: The Board committed to an ongoing review of the Budget Task Force recommendations to ascertain feasible implementation strategies.
decisions.quote: committed to an ongoing review of the recommendations to ascertain feasible implementation strategies.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Director reported FY2024 unaudited total revenue collections surpassed budget projections.
budget_items.quote: total revenue collections stood at $48,390,000, surpassing budget projections by achieving 101.4%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Investment income realized well above projection.
budget_items.quote: investment income notably exceeded expectations, realizing $414,000, equivalent to 484% of the projection.
local receipts exceeded estimates, bringing in $6,940,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State aid reached 96% of projected estimates, with Chapter 70 and unrestricted local government aid fully funded.
budget_items.quote: state aid reached 96% of projected estimates, with complete funding for chapter 70 and unrestricted local government aid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total expenditures were 96.7% of budget and 1.78% lower than FY2023.
budget_items.quote: total expenditures amounted to $46,463,000, representing 96.7% of the budget, with actual expenditures being 1.78% lower than in fy2023.
certified free cash was established at $2,270,000.
the tax rate was confirmed at $14.36.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bids exceeded expectations by about $62,000, plus engineering oversight costs; ARPA remaining funds proposed to close the gap contingent on bid evaluation.
Rot repairs discovered during floor work described as manageable.
budget_items.quote: some unforeseen issues with rotting have been discovered, though they are manageable with repairs costing under $1,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Approximately $83,000 of ARPA funds remained unallocated.
budget_items.quote: including approximately $83,000 yet to be allocated.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended augmenting staff payroll and IT funds because external IT support costs more than a network administrator.
budget_items.quote: augmenting funds devoted to addressing staff payroll and it challenges by approximately $12,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended increasing the DPW fund for tree removal and other contingencies.
budget_items.quote: he recommended increasing the department of public works (dpw) fund allocation by $23,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An allocation to cover anticipated town hall overruns was confirmed, with a remaining contingency.
budget_items.quote: an allocation of $32,500 to cover anticipated town hall capital cost overruns was confirmed, sustaining a $10,000 budgetary contingency for pressing needs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Q1 FY2025 uncollectible ambulance bills written off the books; collection continues through a collection company.
budget_items.quote: the total amount of $26,318.68 in uncollectible bills was submitted for consideration to be written off the books.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Retaining a foreclosed property would require a formal appraisal (an expense) and payment of the difference between appraisal and accumulated taxes, penalties and interest.
budget_items.quote: mr. terenzini also highlighted the necessity of a formal appraisal, which would entail expenses, to assess the current market value

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public commenter suggested a 5.5% annual tax increase as a possible strategy.
budget_items.quote: suggesting a 5.5% annual tax increase as a possible strategy.
